apps/backend/src/domains/ai/infrastructu.reason: AI_BUDGET_HARD_BREACHED, AI_BUDGET_SOFT_BREACHED and AI_ZERO_RETENTION_UNAVAILABLE: signals with no write behind them, raised on every AI pre-flight from cached spend or tenant settings, so they must not add a database write per call or need the database to be up. AI_INVOCATION_RECORDED, which has a write, goes through the outbox.

apps/backend/src/domains/ai/routing/ai-r.reason: AI_ZERO_RETENTION_UNAVAILABLE: a signal with no write behind it, raised on the AI call path when the tenant's retention policy rules out every route, so it must not add a database write per call or need the database to be up. It joins the same signal in ai-telemetry.service.ts, which keeps its emit until the language callers move onto the resolver; that entry then shrinks by one.

packages/appshore/platform/src/infrastru.reason: NOTIFICATION_SENT: an in-process signal for the SSE bridge (it plays the new-notification sound). The notification row is the durable record and the inbox query finds it on the next fetch; through the outbox every in-app notification would also become an events-queue job and an event-log row, and a relayed copy would fire where no SSE client is connected.
